component.name: Minitela
component.summary: Control the mini screen of the Positivo Vision laptop

description.p: Shows the time, weather, battery, connections, a reminder and WhatsApp messages on the small screen next to the keyboard of the Positivo Vision R15M, and lets you choose its GIF. An independent, open source replacement for the official app that works on any distribution.

ul.li: Weather forecast for the chosen city, without an API key
The laptop's mini screen key switches pages
The mini screen turns off when the laptop suspends or the session is locked
Factory GIFs, imported from the official package

description.p: The mini screen needs a one-time setup on the host system, which the app explains. It gives the logged-in user access to the device and nothing else.
Not affiliated with Positivo Tecnologia or PoliCorp Tecnologia.
First preview, tested on the Positivo Vision R15M with Arch Linux.
